value.rationale: The result solves the full natural optimization problem of choosing a single finite partition support able to refine every <=k-block target up to atom renaming: it provides a necessary-and-sufficient local test, a constructive extremizer, exact maximum atom capacity at any block budget and the minimum support-block count at every finite ground-set size. This gives resource information omitted from the related countable existence theorem and is not merely the k=2 textbook case.
